column7: UpdateRole classified an explicit assignable-scope change (widening: fail closed; narrowing: owed, not blocked by an audit outage) and wrote its audit text from a plain in-transaction GetRole. Under Postgres READ COMMITTED a narrowing committed by another replica between that read and the write turned a project -> global widening into an owed any -> global narrowing with the wrong audit row. Each UpdateRole transaction now reads the role with tx.LockRoleForUpdate (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) first, so a concurrent update waits. Red on main. Default-ci halves: internal/core/guards TestUpdateRole_ClassifiesFromALockedRead, internal/storage/store TestLockRoleForUpdate_DialectMatchedLocking.
